queer_characters.name: Emma Nolan
queer_characters.notes: Central protagonist, a 17-year-old lesbian navigating her identity after parental rejection; portrayed with courage facing bullying and given a happy, affirming ending.

queer_characters.name: Alyssa Greene
queer_characters.notes: Emma's girlfriend, depicted as closeted and initially unsupportive due to fear; the closeted arc resolves into an openly celebrated relationship by the film's end.

contributor_notes: Source describes a musical centered on lesbian teen Emma and her girlfriend Alyssa, ending with an inclusive, happy prom. Critical reception was mixed, with concern raised about a straight actor's flamboyant supporting performance leaning into stereotype — that supporting character (one of the four Broadway actors) is not named in the source, so no character entry was drafted; a maintainer should verify names, identities, and whether a stereotype-related rep_quality/trope tag applies. Audio and subtitle languages were not mentioned in the source.
